verses.original: הִנְנִ֤י שֹׁלֵחַ֙ מַלְאָכִ֔י וּפִנָּה־ דֶ֖רֶךְ לְפָנָ֑י וּפִתְאֹם֩ יָב֨וֹא אֶל־ הֵיכָל֜וֹ הָאָד֣וֹן׀ אֲשֶׁר־ אַתֶּ֣ם מְבַקְשִׁ֗ים וּמַלְאַ֨ךְ הַבְּרִ֜ית אֲשֶׁר־ אַתֶּ֤ם חֲפֵצִים֙ הִנֵּה־ בָ֔א אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî šō·lê·aḥ mal·’ā·ḵî ū·p̄in·nāh- ḏe·reḵ lə·p̄ā·nāy ū·p̄iṯ·’ōm yā·ḇō·w ’el- hê·ḵā·lōw hā·’ā·ḏō·wn ’ă·šer- ’at·tem mə·ḇaq·šîm ū·mal·’aḵ hab·bə·rîṯ ’ă·šer- ’at·tem ḥă·p̄ê·ṣîm hin·nêh- ḇā ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Behold I will send My messenger who will prepare the way before Me Then the Lord whom you seek will suddenly come to His temple the Messenger of the covenant in whom you delight see He is coming says the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: וּמִ֤י מְכַלְכֵּל֙ אֶת־ י֣וֹם בּוֹא֔וֹ וּמִ֥י הָעֹמֵ֖ד בְּהֵרָֽאוֹת֑וֹ כִּֽי־ הוּא֙ כְּאֵ֣שׁ מְצָרֵ֔ף וּכְבֹרִ֖ית מְכַבְּסִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mî mə·ḵal·kêl ’eṯ- yō·wm bō·w·’ōw ū·mî hā·‘ō·mêḏ bə·hê·rā·’ō·w·ṯōw kî- hū kə·’êš mə·ṣā·rêp̄ ū·ḵə·ḇō·rîṯ mə·ḵab·bə·sîm
verses.literal: But who can endure the day of His coming And who can stand when He appears For He will be like a refiner’s fire like a launderer’s soap

verses.original: וְיָשַׁ֨ב מְצָרֵ֤ף וּמְטַהֵר֙ כֶּ֔סֶף וְטִהַ֤ר אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ לֵוִי֙ וְזִקַּ֣ק אֹתָ֔ם כַּזָּהָ֖ב וְכַכָּ֑סֶף וְהָיוּ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה מַגִּישֵׁ֥י מִנְחָ֖ה בִּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·šaḇ mə·ṣā·rêp̄ ū·mə·ṭa·hêr ke·sep̄ wə·ṭi·har ’eṯ- bə·nê- lê·wî wə·ziq·qaq ’ō·ṯām kaz·zā·hāḇ wə·ḵak·kā·sep̄ wə·hā·yū Yah·weh mag·gî·šê min·ḥāh biṣ·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: And He will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver He will purify the sons of Levi and refine them like gold and silver . . . Then they will present offerings to the LORD in righteousness

verses.original: וְעָֽרְבָה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה מִנְחַ֥ת יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּימֵ֣י עוֹלָ֔ם וּכְשָׁנִ֖ים קַדְמֹנִיּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·rə·ḇāh Yah·weh min·ḥaṯ yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim kî·mê ‘ō·w·lām ū·ḵə·šā·nîm qaḏ·mō·nî·yō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then the offerings of Judah and Jerusalem will please the LORD as in days of old and years gone by

verses.original: וְקָרַבְתִּ֣י אֲלֵיכֶם֮ לַמִּשְׁפָּט֒ וְהָיִ֣יתִי׀ עֵ֣ד מְמַהֵ֗ר בַּֽמְכַשְּׁפִים֙ וּבַמְנָ֣אֲפִ֔ים וּבַנִּשְׁבָּעִ֖ים לַשָּׁ֑קֶר וּבְעֹשְׁקֵ֣י שְׂכַר־ שָׂ֠כִיר אַלְמָנָ֨ה וְיָת֤וֹם וּמַטֵּי־ גֵר֙ וְלֹ֣א יְרֵא֔וּנִי אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·qā·raḇ·tî ’ă·lê·ḵem lam·miš·pāṭ wə·hā·yî·ṯî ‘êḏ mə·ma·hêr bam·ḵaš·šə·p̄îm ū·ḇam·nā·’ă·p̄îm ū·ḇan·niš·bā·‘îm laš·šā·qer ū·ḇə·‘ō·šə·qê śə·ḵa·r·śā- śā·k̲îr ’al·mā·nāh wə·yā·ṯō·wm ū·maṭ·ṭê- ḡêr wə·lō yə·rê·’ū·nî ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then I will draw near to you for judgment And I will be a swift witness against sorcerers and adulterers and perjurers against oppressors of the widowed and fatherless and against those who defraud laborers of their wages and deny justice to the foreigner but do not fear Me says the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לֹ֣א שָׁנִ֑יתִי וְאַתֶּ֥ם בְּנֵֽי־ יַעֲקֹ֖ב לֹ֥א כְלִיתֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh lō šā·nî·ṯî wə·’at·tem bə·nê- ya·‘ă·qōḇ lō ḵə·lî·ṯem
verses.literal: Because I the LORD do not change you descendants of Jacob have not been destroyed

verses.original: לְמִימֵ֨י אֲבֹתֵיכֶ֜ם סַרְתֶּ֤ם מֵֽחֻקַּי֙ וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַרְתֶּ֔ם שׁ֤וּבוּ אֵלַי֙ וְאָשׁ֣וּבָה אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בַּמֶּ֥ה נָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.transliteration: lə·mî·mê ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem sar·tem mê·ḥuq·qay wə·lō šə·mar·tem šū·ḇū ’ê·lay wə·’ā·šū·ḇāh ’ă·lê·ḵem ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wa·’ă·mar·tem bam·meh nā·šūḇ
verses.literal: Yet from the days of your fathers you have turned away from My statutes and have not kept them Return to Me and I will return to you says the LORD of Hosts But you ask How can we return

verses.original: הֲיִקְבַּ֨ע אָדָ֜ם אֱלֹהִ֗ים כִּ֤י אַתֶּם֙ קֹבְעִ֣ים אֹתִ֔י וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם בַּמֶּ֣ה קְבַעֲנ֑וּךָ הַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֖ר וְהַתְּרוּמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yiq·ba‘ ’ā·ḏām ’ĕ·lō·hîm kî ’at·tem qō·ḇə·‘îm ’ō·ṯî wa·’ă·mar·tem bam·meh qə·ḇa·‘ă·nū·ḵā ham·ma·‘ă·śêr wə·hat·tə·rū·māh
verses.literal: Will a man rob God Yet you are robbing Me But you ask How do we rob You In tithes and offerings

verses.original: בַּמְּאֵרָה֙ אַתֶּ֣ם נֵֽאָרִ֔ים וְאֹתִ֖י אַתֶּ֣ם קֹבְעִ֑ים הַגּ֖וֹי כֻּלּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bam·mə·’ê·rāh ’at·tem nê·’ā·rîm wə·’ō·ṯî ’at·tem qō·ḇə·‘îm hag·gō·w kul·lōw
verses.literal: You are cursed with a curse yet you the whole nation are still robbing Me

verses.original: הָבִ֨יאוּ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַֽמַּעֲשֵׂ֜ר אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית הָאוֹצָ֗ר וִיהִ֥י טֶ֙רֶף֙ בְּבֵיתִ֔י וּבְחָנ֤וּנִי נָא֙ בָּזֹ֔את אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת אִם־ לֹ֧א אֶפְתַּ֣ח לָכֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת אֲרֻבּ֣וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַהֲרִיקֹתִ֥י לָכֶ֛ם בְּרָכָ֖ה עַד־ בְּלִי־ דָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇî·’ū ’eṯ- kāl- ham·ma·‘ă·śêr ’el- bêṯ hā·’ō·w·ṣār wî·hî ṭe·rep̄ bə·ḇê·ṯî ū·ḇə·ḥā·nū·nî nā bā·zōṯ ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’im- lō ’ep̄·taḥ lā·ḵem ’êṯ ’ă·rub·bō·wṯ haš·šā·ma·yim wa·hă·rî·qō·ṯî lā·ḵem bə·rā·ḵāh ‘aḏ- bə·lî- ḏāy
verses.literal: Bring the full tithe into the storehouse . . . so that there may be food in My house Test Me . . . in this says the LORD of Hosts See if I will not open the windows of heaven and pour out for you blessing . . . without measure

verses.original: וְגָעַרְתִּ֤י לָכֶם֙ בָּֽאֹכֵ֔ל וְלֹֽא־ יַשְׁחִ֥ת לָכֶ֖ם אֶת־ פְּרִ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֑ה וְלֹא־ תְשַׁכֵּ֨ל לָכֶ֤ם הַגֶּ֙פֶן֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡā·‘ar·tî lā·ḵem bā·’ō·ḵêl wə·lō- yaš·ḥiṯ lā·ḵem ’eṯ- pə·rî hā·’ă·ḏā·māh wə·lō- ṯə·šak·kêl lā·ḵem hag·ge·p̄en baś·śā·ḏeh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: I will rebuke the devourer for you so that it will not destroy the fruits of your land and the vine in your field will not fail to produce fruit says the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: וְאִשְּׁר֥וּ אֶתְכֶ֖ם כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם כִּֽי־ תִהְי֤וּ אַתֶּם֙ אֶ֣רֶץ חֵ֔פֶץ אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’iš·šə·rū ’eṯ·ḵem kāl- hag·gō·w·yim kî- ṯih·yū ’at·tem ’e·reṣ ḥê·p̄eṣ ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then all the nations will call you blessed for you will be a land of delight says the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: חָזְק֥וּ עָלַ֛י דִּבְרֵיכֶ֖ם אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וַאֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם מַה־ נִּדְבַּ֖רְנוּ עָלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥā·zə·qū ‘ā·lay diḇ·rê·ḵem ’ā·mar Yah·weh wa·’ă·mar·tem mah- niḏ·bar·nū ‘ā·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Your words against Me have been harsh says the LORD Yet you ask What have we spoken against You

verses.original: אֲמַרְתֶּ֕ם שָׁ֖וְא עֲבֹ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֑ים וּמַה־ בֶּ֗צַע כִּ֤י שָׁמַ֙רְנוּ֙ מִשְׁמַרְתּ֔וֹ וְכִ֤י הָלַ֙כְנוּ֙ קְדֹ֣רַנִּ֔ית מִפְּנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה צְבָאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·mar·tem šāw ‘ă·ḇōḏ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ū·mah- be·ṣa‘ kî šā·mar·nū miš·mar·tōw wə·ḵî hā·laḵ·nū qə·ḏō·ran·nîṯ mip·pə·nê Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: You have said It is futile to serve God What have we gained . . . by keeping His requirements . . . and walking mournfully before the LORD of Hosts

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה אֲנַ֖חְנוּ מְאַשְּׁרִ֣ים זֵדִ֑ים גַּם־ נִבְנוּ֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י רִשְׁעָ֔ה גַּ֧ם בָּחֲנ֛וּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים וַיִּמָּלֵֽטוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’ă·naḥ·nū mə·’aš·šə·rîm zê·ḏîm gam- niḇ·nū ‘ō·śê riš·‘āh gam bā·ḥă·nū ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yim·mā·lê·ṭū
verses.literal: So now we call the arrogant blessed Not only do evildoers . . . prosper they even test God and escape

verses.original: אָ֧ז נִדְבְּר֛וּ יִרְאֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ רֵעֵ֑הוּ וַיַּקְשֵׁ֤ב יְהוָה֙ וַיִּשְׁמָ֔ע וַ֠יִּכָּתֵב סֵ֣פֶר זִכָּר֤וֹן לְפָנָיו֙ לְיִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּלְחֹשְׁבֵ֖י שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz niḏ·bə·rū yir·’ê Yah·weh ’îš ’eṯ- rê·‘ê·hū way·yaq·šêḇ Yah·weh way·yiš·mā‘ way·yik·kā·ṯêḇ sê·p̄er zik·kā·rō·wn lə·p̄ā·nāw lə·yir·’ê Yah·weh ū·lə·ḥō·šə·ḇê šə·mōw
verses.literal: At that time those who feared the LORD spoke with one . . . another and the LORD listened and heard them So a scroll of remembrance was written before Him regarding those who feared the LORD and honored His name

verses.original: וְהָ֣יוּ לִ֗י אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת לַיּ֕וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲנִ֖י עֹשֶׂ֣ה סְגֻלָּ֑ה וְחָמַלְתִּ֣י עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ יַחְמֹ֣ל אִ֔ישׁ עַל־ בְּנ֖וֹ הָעֹבֵ֥ד אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū lî ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ lay·yō·wm ’ă·šer ’ă·nî ‘ō·śeh sə·ḡul·lāh wə·ḥā·mal·tî ‘ă·lê·hem ka·’ă·šer yaḥ·mōl ’îš ‘al- bə·nōw hā·‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: They will be Mine says the LORD of Hosts on the day when I prepare My treasured possession And I will spare them as a man spares his own son who serves him

verses.original: וְשַׁבְתֶּם֙ וּרְאִיתֶ֔ם בֵּ֥ין צַדִּ֖יק לְרָשָׁ֑ע בֵּ֚ין עֹבֵ֣ד אֱלֹהִ֔ים לַאֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א עֲבָדֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·šaḇ·tem ū·rə·’î·ṯem bên ṣad·dîq lə·rā·šā‘ bên ‘ō·ḇêḏ ’ĕ·lō·hîm la·’ă·šer lō ‘ă·ḇā·ḏōw
verses.literal: So you will again distinguish between the righteous and the wicked between those who serve God and those who do not . . .
